title: Copy-loop exit labels
statement: For a natural number $K_0$, assign an exit label to each copy site. A radius copy proceeds to the logarithm copy at the same stage, and a logarithm copy exits to the width increment at that stage. An indexed addition copy proceeds to the next addition when its index plus one is less than $K_0$, and otherwise exits to the width clear at that stage. A width-counter copy proceeds to the shift phase at step zero; a first base copy exits to the width-work exit at the second-search stage and otherwise proceeds to the second base copy; a second base copy exits to the width-work exit at its stage. A base-access copy proceeds to the index-access copy at the same site, an index-access copy proceeds to the outward memory-access phase at that site, and the iteration copy exits to the increment of $s_1$.
hypotheses_covered: Copy site; indexed additions use an index below $K_0$
